segments.source: Felipe es Ingeniero Civil Eléctrico y Master en Ingeniería Eléctrica de la Universidad de Chile. Trabajó durante más de 4 años en proyectos de I+D en temas de Computer Vision (CV), desarrollando soluciones para la industria desde la academia. Además, ha sido parte del equipo docente del curso de robótica móvil Duckietown Engineering Chile en la Universidad de Chile, enfocándose especialmente en el área de CV y Machine Learning. Felipe actualmente es presidente de Corporación Cuac, organización sin fines de lucro que busca enseñar y realizar divulgación científica sobre temas de Robótica, Inteligencia Artificial y Ciencia de Datos, con el fin de democratizar dicho conocimiento. Actualmente se desempeña como AI Specialist in Anastasia.
segments.en: Felipe is a Civil Electrical Engineer and has a Master in Electrical Engineering from the University of Chile. He worked for more than 4 years on R&D projects on Computer Vision (CV) issues, developing solutions for the industry from academia. Additionally, he has been part of the teaching team for the Duckietown Engineering Chile mobile robotics course at the University of Chile, focusing especially on the area of ​​CV and Machine Learning. Felipe is currently president of Corporación Cuac, a non-profit organization that seeks to teach and carry out scientific dissemination on topics of Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, in order to democratize said knowledge. He currently works as AI Specialist in Anastasia.

segments.source: Cesar was born in Lima, Peru. He’s a System Engineer and a MSc Candidate. Appasionate for Maths and Techonology/AI that became him in a specialized Machine Learning/Deep Learning Engineer. He has built and deploy many machine learning algorithms for a variety industries such as Retail, Telco and Bank. Currently, he works at Rappi for the Rappibank Latam team. Also, he has a vast experience in AWS Cloud, and has earned an AWS Machine Learning Specialty Certification. Moreover, he is an active research in new topics of Artificial Intelligence with research publications.
